d: Ebola is spreading across Africa as health authorities struggle to contain the deadly outbreak. Nigeria has confirmed its first case of the Bundibugyo strain in Abuja, involving a woman who travelled to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo before transiting through Uganda. Authorities have identified 44 contacts and are tracing potential exposures. With more than 9,500 infections and 4,600 deaths reported across the wider outbreak, cases in Nigeria and Kenya raise new concerns about the virus spreading across borders.
